wid-us-top-shares.name: US top income shares (pre-tax)
wid-us-top-shares.update_frequency: WID updates annually; we re-sync at least every 120 days
wid-us-top-shares.methodology: Share of pre-tax national income (before taxes and transfers, after pension/unemployment insurance) received by each group, equal-split among adult couples, age 20+. WID variable sptincj992. Pre-tax shares are the standard series in the Piketty–Saez tradition; post-tax shares are lower at the top.

swiid-gini.name: Gini coefficients, cross-national (SWIID)
swiid-gini.source_org: Standardized World Income Inequality Database (Frederick Solt)
swiid-gini.update_frequency: SWIID releases roughly annually; we re-sync at least every 120 days
swiid-gini.methodology: Disposable-income (post-tax, post-transfer) Gini on a 0–100 scale, with SWIID's standard-error band reflecting the uncertainty introduced by harmonizing national sources. Market-income Gini shown where available. SWIID standardizes differing national definitions (household vs. individual, gross vs. net); see Solt (2020).
